sloka: काल पाश परिक्षिप्ता भवंति पुरुषा हि ये ।कार्य अकार्यम् न जानन्ति ते निरस्त षड् इन्द्रियाः ॥३-३०-१५॥
transliteration: kāla pāśa parikṣiptā bhavaṁti puruṣā hi ye ।kārya akāryam na jānanti te nirasta ṣaḍ indriyāḥ ॥3-30-15॥

translations.english: Those bound by the noose of death, do not know what to and what not to do, as their six senses cease to function.
